name: Hitchens AI
tagline: AI dating coach for screenshot replies, profile openers, and practice chats
description: Hitchens AI is an AI dating coach focused on first messages and replies. In the Android beta, upload a chat or dating profile screenshot to get three reply styles based on that specific conversation. The public website offers nine fictional chats with feedback and English and Hinglish examples. Anyone can try the browser practice without signing in. The Android app is in closed beta in India. The practice examples cover opening on a dating profile, responding to a short message, suggesting plans, and handling a quiet chat. Each scenario explains what makes a reply fit.
